evals.prompt: Git commit, git push, and deploy these changes live.
evals.expected_output: Resolve scope and destination, reuse or run relevant checks, stage only approved changes, run git diff --cached --check and a staged secret scan before committing, push without force-pushing, deploy the validated commit, and verify the specific delivered change on the live target.
assertions: Inspects git status, upstream, and ahead commits before pushing
Stages approved files before running git diff --cached --check and gitleaks git --staged --redact
Verifies the delivered change on the live target rather than stopping at deploy exit code 0
Reports commit SHA, deployment target or ID, and live verification result

evals.prompt: Ship this fix live and rebuild the Worker.
evals.expected_output: Trigger commit-push-deploy even though 'commit' was omitted, verify target repo/branch/deploy profile, commit and push approved changes if uncommitted, deploy using the project's documented script, and verify the changed live endpoint behavior.
assertions: Triggers commit-push-deploy even when the word commit is omitted
Uses the project's documented deploy script and profile
Checks live endpoint behavior after deployment

evals.prompt: Push and deploy the pricing update, but leave my unfinished auth refactor in the working tree untouched.
evals.expected_output: Stage only the approved pricing files, keep unrelated auth files unstaged, commit and push, and deploy from a clean worktree at the pushed commit if the deploy tool bundles the working tree.
assertions: Deploys from a clean worktree at the pushed commit when the deploy tool bundles the working tree
Does not leak unrelated dirty files into the commit or live artifact

evals.prompt: Just commit these changes locally; do not push or deploy yet.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger commit-push-deploy; handle as a plain commit-only request without pushing or deploying.
assertions: Does not trigger commit-push-deploy for a commit-only request

evals.prompt: Open a pull request for this branch so the team can review it.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger commit-push-deploy; route to a PR workflow rather than releasing live.
assertions: Does not trigger commit-push-deploy for a PR-only request
